description: Create a new skill with custom properties. Omitted fields use new-skill defaults: stypeId 1 (Magic), scope 1, occasion 1 (battle only), hitType derived — 0 certain for recovery or ally/user scopes, else 2 magical for Magic skills, else 1 physical if it deals damage, else 0. An effect referencing a missing record throws: Add/Remove State (code 21/22) → state, Learn Skill (43) → skill, Common Event (44) → common event.

dryRun.description: Preview only: return a diff of what would change without writing to disk.

hitType.description: 0 certain hit, 1 physical (HIT/EVA, counterable), 2 magical (MEV, reflectable). Default derived from stypeId/scope/damage

occasion.description: Usable: 0 always, 1 battle only (default), 2 menu only, 3 never

scope.description: Target scope (1=enemy single, 2=enemy all, 7=ally all, etc.)

speed.description: Speed correction (-2000..2000; positive acts earlier). Default 0

stypeId.description: Skill type (0=none — typical for enemy-only skills, not sealed by Silence; 1=magic, 2=special, etc.). Default 1

tpGain.description: User TP gained on use. Default 0

name: create_skill
